svg.title: OOP Cold Chain UML overview
svg.desc: White-background UML and architecture diagram for the cold-chain shipment simulator, backend, dashboard, domain model, and PostgreSQL schema.
svg.text: Simulator · Crow backend · Domain model · Dashboard · PostgreSQL
Blue solid: association / flow · dashed: dependency · hollow arrow: implementation
Also queries PostgreSQL for active shipment / device / container data.
External map tiles and OSRM require internet.
The API publishes accepted telemetry to connected dashboard clients via WebSocket.

svg.text: Foreign keys: shipments → containers / vehicles; devices → shipments;
Simulator also queries shipments, devices and containers directly.
Entities, value objects, aggregate root, domain event, repository contract
Generated from current source structure. Map tiles: Esri; route geometry: OSRM; persistent data: PostgreSQL.
